_doc: Stream E (M2). Quests for zone 'saint_orrins_rise' (Saint Orrin's Rise). Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/province.json).

abbot_wendel.name: Prior Wendel
abbot_wendel.greeting: Welcome, pilgrim. Please wipe your feet. Not on the saint.

sister_hild.name: Sister Hild
sister_hild.greeting: You look like someone who walks into graveyards on purpose.

brother_tobin.name: Brother Tobin
brother_tobin.greeting: I am the abbey's entire guard. I also do the bread.

pilgrim_nell.name: Nell the pilgrim
pilgrim_nell.greeting: I came to pray. The shrine had other plans and also frogs.

quests.name: The Restless Cloister
quests.offer: The dead in our cloister have started getting up for morning prayers. They are not invited. Settle them.
quests.done: Thank you. Morning prayers are once again a living-only affair.

quests.name: Owls in the Belfry
quests.offer: Gallows owls have taken the belfry. Every time I ring the bell, they ring me.
quests.done: The bell rings clean. My ears thank you; my head thanks you more.

quests.name: Candles for the Crypt
quests.offer: Fetch the wax from the cairn rats — they've been eating our candles, so in a sense the candles are already inside them.
quests.done: Slightly chewed. The saint won't mind. The saint has seen worse.

quests.name: A Pilgrim Lost
quests.offer: I left my prayer beads at the drowned shrine when the wisps chased me. Fetch them and tell the Prior I'm not dead.

steps.text: Tell Prior Wendel that Nell lives

quests.done: Not dead! Excellent. That saves a great deal of paperwork.

quests.name: The Saint's Bones
quests.offer: Something below the Rise is moving the saint's bones about. Go down and see what has taken an interest.

steps.text: Defeat what waits at the bottom

quests.done: The saint rests. And so, for the first time this month, do I.

quests.name: Something on the Rise
quests.offer: There's a beast out on the Rise the pilgrims won't stop talking about. Kill it so they talk about the saint again.
quests.done: Ah, wonderful. Now they'll talk about you instead. Still not the saint.
